title: Don’t overlook Elektron’s budget electronic music instruments
summary: I keep coming back to the criminally slept-on Model:Samples and Model:Cycles. When I’m asked what to buy if you want to get into making electronic music, I often recommend Elektron’s budget-minded Model:Samples and Model:Cycles grooveboxes.
